title: AM/NS India Approved as 1st Anchor Partner Under ₹60,000-Cr PM-SETU Scheme
summary: Andhra Pradesh becomes 1st state to operationalise industry-led management of ITIs.

blocks.content: Andhra Pradesh becomes 1st state to operationalise industry-led management of ITIs.

items: Anchor Partner: ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel India approved for Visakhapatnam ITI cluster under PM-SETU.
PM-SETU Mandate: Upgrades 1,000 government ITIs across India using a hub-and-spoke model.
Steering Committee: National Steering Committee chaired by Skill Secretary Debashree Mukherjee.
